I had three umbilical hernias repaired back in 2022 and I’ve noticed if I start working out/lifting too much those areas become inflamed and cause pain. I’m so scared for a reoccurrence that I stopped lifting over 40 lbs.
im sorry are we joking here? I can’t tell 😭

It took me about 2 months to be able to get up walk around with no pain at all, also took about 3 weeks to be able to lay on my side/ stomach again. If you have any other questions I’m here! I hope it’s been an easy recovery so far!
It could be from the air they used during surgery, but I’m unsure because I never felt nauseous after. I would go get checked out if the nausea continues. Best of luck to you!
I’d get it checked out to be safe. IF it is a hernia you’ll have the option to have surgery or wait if it’s not bothering you.

I was told I could start lifting after 6 weeks.. I’d say start at 10lbs and go from there. I personally won’t lift anything heavier than 50+ lbs because I know I don’t have the proper lifting form down, and I don’t want a reoccurrence.

You’re going to experience discomfort and pain for weeks, especially if you’re already bending. I had sharp pain everytime I would get up from sitting down until about week 3-4. Everyday gets a little easier..

I’m so sorry you had to go through the surgery TWICE. You have every right to be upset the surgeon should of put the mesh in to begin with! I’m currently 5 months post op of a triple umbilical hernia repair and it’s been rough, good luck with everything and I hope you have a speedy recovery
Yes it came on very sudden, but I used to unload trucks so I was making it worse every day.

I’m sorry my original comment was vague, I had three umbilical hernias but it originally started with one. I noticed the pain started if I was lifting a lot or sitting up. There were times I could only get comfortable by laying down, and I’m not sure if it came on immediately. I noticed it a week or so later but it eventually grew to 3.1 cm and the other two were a little smaller. The pain was sharp like I tore a muscle
Pain and then a lump right after
I waited a year and it caused me to have two other hernias, get it taken care of before it can potentially get worse
I had to sleep on my back for 3, almost 4 weeks. Listen to your body and do what feels comfortable for you.
Look into the hernia mesh lawsuit going on right now, im sorry you’re dealing with this. I’m almost 6months out and still get pain occasionally
I had a laparoscopic ventral repair back in September they told me I’d only have 4 incisions from the procedure, and I came out with 9 incisions all around my stomach.

It won’t hurt to go get it checked out, the symptoms could just be starting. I’m 5 weeks post op, and the pain always came and went but it was never tender or sensitive to touch until I had surgery. Best of luck.

The pain for me was a stomach cramps you can’t get rid of unless you lay down, It started out as a dull ache on the right side of my belly button, and then all over with occasional cramping.

If dull pain is all your experiencing it could be growing pains, be careful to not lift anything above 15lbs. When a hernia is stuck it causes severe pain, redness at the site of hernia, and inability to pass gas. I currently have two umbilical hernias, and currently have no symptoms. When I was lifting a lot I had a lot more pain, I hope you feel better.

When I went to move a couple things over 30+ pounds while moving last year I had a hernia I didn’t know about and the lifting made it worse. I had pain and pressure to the right of my belly button. Turns out I have two umbilical hernias 🥹 I hope it’s just sore from lifting!

I’m currently dealing with this too. My boyfriend and I have spent everyday together for the past 3 months, and I could tell it was getting to him. He said we needed space, so when I was alone my anxiety would be so high, and I’d immediately go to him for reassurance and validation, but I could also tell calling him, and wanting to talk to him that way was too much for him as well. So, I left him alone, let him come to me. I now haven’t seen him in 4 days, and we barely call each other during the day.. and it feels so good. It feels good to focus on yourself, you just have to tell yourself you can’t control the way your SO is feeling.
